newsitem.title: UK: Rolls-Royce firm ahead of air show, results.
newsitem.headline: Rolls-Royce firm ahead of air show, results.

text.p: Shares in Rolls-Royce were higher on Wednesday in active trade ahead of the company's half year results on Thursday and amid generally positive comments on the company's prospects, dealers said.
The shares were 3-1/2p higher at 235p by 0859 GMT in trade of over four million shares.
On Tuesday the shares rose after weekend press reports raised hopes that new engine orders up to the value of $1 billion were in the pipeline.
Traders said hopes were also raised for good news from the Farnborough International air show which begins on Sunday, where the company will showcase its products.
"We've had some promising comments lately, in the press, and ahead of the air show and results," said one trader.
The company is expected to report pre-exceptional half-year profits in the range of 70 to 99 million stg on Thursday compared with 70 million stg for the same period last year.
